Huber weather.description: Robust Huber regression, scaled target, 100-day window

Spline weather.description: Quadratic splines with 4 knots, ridge alpha 100, compact history/weather features

SVR weather.description: RBF support vector regression C=5, epsilon .08, standardized features and target

Nearest neighbors.description: 30 nearest hourly feature vectors, distance weights

Boosted weather MAE.description: HistGradientBoosting absolute error, 160 iterations, 10 leaves, L2 20

CatBoost MAE.description: 350 iterations, depth 4, learning rate .05, L2 10, MAE loss

CatBoost RMSE.description: 400 iterations, depth 6, learning rate .04, L2 20, RMSE loss

Extra Trees weather.description: 150 extremely randomized trees, depth 14, minimum leaf 6

MLP weather.description: Tanh MLP 32/16, alpha 1, Adam, maximum 2000 epochs, compact features, no random validation split

Daily PCA ridge.description: Five principal components of the demeaned daily shape plus daily mean, ridge alpha 100

Daily MLP.description: Daily 24-output MLP 32/16, LBFGS, alpha 5, maximum 800 iterations; training-only scaling

Weather analog days.description: Five nearest daily profiles using scaled prior-generation and forecast-weather summaries

Independent mean ensemble.description: Equal mean of the fixed seven-model pool

Independent median ensemble.description: Pointwise median of the fixed seven-model pool

Independent inverse-error blend.description: Inverse squared MAE weights on earlier out-of-sample errors

Independent convex stack.description: Nonnegative sum-to-one MAE weights on earlier out-of-sample errors

Independent ridge stack.description: Ridge alpha 100 fitted on earlier out-of-sample predictions

Independent full-pool convex.description: Convex MAE stack over all 19 base and five fixed-pool ensemble models

Independent full-pool top3.description: Equal mean of the three lowest earlier out-of-sample MAE candidates

Independent full-pool ridge.description: Ridge alpha 100 on all 24 earlier independent candidates

availability: ERP historical issue/revision timestamps are unavailable; availability on D+1 is assumed for retrospective evaluation.
weather: Four-location GFS forecasts at nominal 48-hour lead, not observed/reanalysis weather.
selection: 14 earlier selection origins, one-day embargo, fixed evaluation window; no evaluation labels select each window champion.
scope: Independent models only. Prior-day workbook P1 and generation-availability fields are lagged auxiliary inputs; no target-day PGCB scenario.
interpretation: Retrospective development evidence on current ERP snapshots; neither window is a fresh prospective or vintage-verified holdout.
forecast_issue_timing: Recorded at fit completion; forward preview is experimental and may be issued after the operating day began.
